findings.heading: Interactive plots / Graphiques interactifs
findings.proposition: The English tells the reader that further material on shiny is on the Dashboards with Shiny page and links to it (shiny_basics.qmd); the French keeps the sentence but the reference [Dashboards with Shiny] carries no target, so no pointer to that page is delivered.
findings.reader_consequence: The French reader is told to read more about shiny elsewhere but gets literal bracketed text instead of a working link, and cannot reach shiny_basics.fr.qmd from this page. Other French chapters (data_used.fr.qmd:254) do link to shiny_basics.fr.qmd, so the omission is specific to this chapter.

findings.heading: Plot with `ggplotly()` / Tracer avec `ggplotly()`
findings.proposition: The English says the last toolbar control adjusts WHETHER data are shown while the pointer is not hovering on the line (a toggle between two hover modes); the French says the control makes the data display when you are not hovering, stating one fixed effect rather than a choice.
findings.reader_consequence: The French reader expects the button to switch data display on, and does not realise it selects between hover comparison modes, so they misread what the last modebar icon does.
